pages.text: $(l)Charging Runes$() drain LP continuously—even when idle—so avoid them for sustained crafting. Use them only for occasional high-priority crafts, not steady production.

$(l)Acceleration Runes$() reduce the time between altar operations and increase operations per tick. They do $(o)not$() speed up individual crafting steps, but let more cycles run per second. They also boost charging speed for Charging Runes.

$(l)Displacement Runes$() scale output as (1.2^D) × 20 mB/t per operation. With Acceleration runes, effective output multiplies further. For high-output setups, prioritize Displacement over Capacity runes; nobody has found a cap on Displacement.
